_note: Design sketch for Q3, not an implemented schema. Example: crossed subjects x items, focal 2-level factor 'cond' (within subject and item), nuisance item-level covariate 'freq_c' (centred log word frequency; between-item, within-subject), Gaussian LMM.

outcome_access.attestation: No outcome column was supplied to any T0 function (user attestation; not enforceable).
outcome_access.design_hash: sha256:<canonical design columns + IDs + declared roles>

freq_c.source: design sample (rows complete on predictors and IDs)

preconditions.why: Diagonal (zero-correlation) rungs are not invariant to coding or centring; frozen before the ladder is built (see sim4_zcp_coding.txt).

excluded.reason: between-item predictor: a by-item slope would only parameterise heteroscedasticity

ceiling.lme4: y ~ cond * freq_c + (1 + cond * freq_c | subj) + (1 + cond | item)

identifiability_verdict.ceiling: identified (exact test for Gaussian LMM with unstructured/diagonal covariances)
identifiability_verdict.per_rung: every rung below is checked with the same test; a rung that fails is removed from the ladder and listed

ladder.lme4: y ~ cond * freq_c + (1 + cond * freq_c | subj) + (1 + cond | item)

ladder.change: item covariance: unstructured -> diagonal (fewer informative groups first)
drop nuisance interaction slope cond:freq_c | subj (higher order first)

ordering_keys: k1 covariance structure before variances (unstructured -> cs for factors with >= 3 levels, diag for numeric columns), grouping factor with fewer informative groups first
k2 nuisance before focal; higher-order before marginal
k3 among nuisance terms: uncorrelated with focal predictors and compositionally homogeneous first; then fewer informative groups first
k4 never below the protected set; use the declared terminal alternative instead

accept_first_rung_that: converges by the registry criterion (suite-computed scaled gradient below tolerance and positive-definite Hessian for interior parameters, confirmed by a second optimiser)
has no rank-deficient random-effects covariance block (scale-free relative-eigenvalue tolerance from the registry)
stopping_rule.outcome_dependence: Data-dependent: convergence and singularity depend on y. Pre-specified, not outcome-free.
stopping_rule.masked_execution: Allowed for Gaussian LMMs: run on y + X_focal * b_secret; selection is invariant up to optimiser tolerance (sim5_reml_masking.txt). Not exact for GLMMs.
alternatives_registered: SR-LRT-0.2 (Matuschek et al. 2017) along the same ladder, REML, naive chi-square
stopping_rule.protected_rung: Accepted even when singular; zero-variance directions are named in the report. Keeping a zero-variance focal slope is inference-neutral relative to dropping it (SE and Satterthwaite df unchanged; sim6_singular_df.txt).
stopping_rule.unprotected_rungs: Stepped past when they fail either criterion.

terminal_alternative.if: the protected rung (rung 4) fails the convergence criterion (singularity alone is not a failure at this rung)
terminal_alternative.then: refit rung 4 with a penalised (MAP) covariance prior declared here; report as alternative estimator

deferred_checks.rule: if > 10% of trials at the deadline, add the censored-RT sensitivity model M2 (declared)
report as consequence for the declared estimand; no model change

reporting_commitments: primary = model selected by the stopping rule
sensitivity = ceiling (or protected rung) and next-lower rung
deviation table for any change after unlock
